title: Manager prep - self notes Q1 2026
content:
Purpose: quick manager prep / talking points for 1:1 with Sarah (manager). Mostly bullets + examples to cite. Not polished.

Summary (30s):
- Q1 focused on stabilizing onboarding experience and launching the new offboarding checklist + manager toolkit.
- Hit adoption targets for the manager toolkit (pilot: 12 teams), reduced new-hire setup time by ~18% for pilot orgs.
- Open items on cross-functional support (engineering infra, SSO edge cases) that need escalations.

Top wins (concrete):
- Manager toolkit pilot launched (v1) — pilot metrics: 12 teams, 48 hires onboarded in pilot cohort, NPS ~4.1/5 from managers (sample n=18).
  - Example feedback: "way easier to get new engineers productive" (ENG-frontend lead).
- Offboarding checklist + automation: automated account removal for 3 SaaS apps via SCIM script -> reduced manual work for IT by ~60% for offboards.
- Hired two contract HRBPs (Maya + Priya) to help with peak recruiting cycle; ramping, both hit first 1:1s and stakeholder transition docs created.

Metrics / impact:
- New-hire time-to-first-PR median: went from 8d -> 6.5d in pilot teams (tracked in Google Sheet, sample size 48).
- Time saved from automated offboarding: estimated 12 hours/week for IT team.
- Manager toolkit adoption: 12/15 invited teams (80%) in pilot opted in.

Stretch wins / qualitative:
- Ran 2 manager office hours to collect real-time feedback; collated feature requests and prioritized backlog.
- Started a cross-functional working group with SRE to address infra-related onboarding friction (liaison: Jonah).

Areas for improvement / honest notes:
- Rollout communications were a bit rushed; missed notifying some people managers across EU timezone -> need a more robust comms schedule for next rollout.
- Instrumentation gaps: onboarding instrumentation lives in 3 sheets and a hacky script; need product/eng support to create a single dashboard (ask below).
- Still seeing SSO/SCIM failures for some legacy apps — need engineering prioritized ticket.

Asks / questions for manager (priority order):
1) Support to get 2 engineer sprints (Platform/Identity) prioritized to finish SCIM reliability work (JIRA: PO-812). Can we escalate in leadership sync?
2) Headcount ask: convert 1 contractor (HRBP) to full-time in Q2 if adoption continues — will propose formal business case with projected SLA improvements. Need your read on urgency.
3) Sponsorship for product dashboard: ask Eng PM to allocate a small scope to consolidate onboarding metrics into a dashboard (estimated 1 sprint).
4) Guidance on compensation calibration conversation I should have with the team lead (Maya) next month — want to align expectations on growth path.

Career / development notes (for manager):
- Short goal: lead a cross-functional productization of onboarding (define requirements, prioritize, launch v2).
- Mid goal (12-18 months): move into a senior people-ops program lead role owning lifecycle automation and tooling.
- Request: mentorship -> would like 3-4 sessions focused on stakeholder influence and prioritization (sample topics: roadmap trade-offs, org alignment).

Risks / blockers:
- If SCIM/SSO reliability not fixed, offboarding automation will hit compliance risk for EU customers (audit note).
- Headcount uncertainty if contractor conversions blocked -> capacity risk during hiring peak in May.

Follow-ups for next 1:1 (concrete):
- Decision on escalations for PO-812 (identity reliability) — need go/no-go for requesting leadership intervention.
- Timeline for contractor conversion decision and budget owner.
- Agree on owner/PM for onboarding metrics dashboard; I'll draft scope doc and share by next Wed.

Notes to self / talking points (short bullets):
- "Pilot showed measurable lift in time-to-first-PR and manager satisfaction; next step scale with better infra support."
- "If we convert contractor, we can guarantee coverage for May hiring push and reduce HRBP context-switching cost."
- "Need your help to make SCIM reliability a leadership priority — framing it as a compliance + new-hire productivity risk works well."

Loose ideas / backlog (unprioritized):
- Manager toolkit v2: add role-specific templates, integrate with learning paths.
- Onboarding dashboard: automated weekly digest to hiring managers.
- Explore small stipend for managers who run structured onboarding (pilot incentive).

References / links I might cite:
- Confluence: People Ops Q1 roadmap (conf-342)
- JIRA: PO-789 (manager-toolkit), PO-812 (SCIM infra)
- Sheet: onboarding-metrics-2026 (internal sheet id)
- Slack thread: #people-ops-onboarding (latest thread link)

TODO before 1:1:
- Draft 1-page ask for SCIM sprint (include risk statement + ROI).
- Prepare short slide with pilot metrics (2 slides).
- Pull raw data for time-to-first-PR to answer any deep-dive questions (source: onboarding-metrics-2026 sheet).

End of notes.
